status: UI art and interaction design only; not a production-code implementation or playable verification.

outputs.state: Before inference, empty search field, full illustrative inventory
After inference, query 通传 filters picker; clicked clue has detail float at far right, complete result remains visible

requirements: Replace 见闻 title with searchable clue input
Click clue text to open right-side floating details without covering either reasoning column
Reduce background heaviness while keeping dark ancient night-camp art

interaction.search: Search acquired clue labels and descriptions; filtering changes picker only. Preserve selected clues and existing reasoning results. Clear input restores available inventory; empty results display 未找到相关线索.
interaction.rowActions: Clue text opens details. Trailing plus adds immediately and becomes a check. Picker remains open for further additions. Selected clue removal uses its adjacent small semi-transparent ×.
interaction.details: Far-right reserved floating area separated from result column by background space. No extra graph edge for detail viewing. Clicking another clue replaces this float's contents. Close clears detail focus. Long contents scroll inside the float.
interaction.layout: At laptop sizes 1366x768 and 1440x900, preserve two main reasoning columns and reserve the right detail band in both states. Do not cover, scale down, or reflow the reasoning columns on open. Exact responsive geometry needs code validation.
interaction.typography: KaiTi throughout; intended implementation body 14px, question/conclusion 18px, button typography separate. Same clue font size, natural-width text/wash, shared left edge; no stretching 3–10 character labels into equal widths.
interaction.viewport: Fixed-size scrollable reasoning viewport, default latest step. Preserve earlier history scrolling.
interaction.motion: Design intent: detail fades/slides in gently from right, approximately 140–180ms; no layout jump; honor reduced-motion preference.
interaction.art: Warm ash-grey dark silk with less brown, weaker mottling and sparse low-contrast camp silhouettes. Faint shallow curved graph edges. Search and detail share translucent dark silk material.
interaction.scope: Inventory and clue detail are art examples retained from prior mockups, not new canonical chapter content or rules.

review: Visual inspection: search input clear control sits inside input, panel close outside; right detail does not overlap right result; background lighter and less mottled. Raster positions approximate, not measured browser layout.

prompts.name: search-and-air-background
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit target: the attached complete historical Chinese strategy game thought-canvas screen. Produce ONE polished full 16:9 game UI art keyframe, not a mood board. This revision is the OPEN SEARCHABLE CLUE PICKER state. Keep the restrained ink-on-silk art direction, small uniform 楷体 KaiTi lettering, natural-width clue washes, current three clues, cinnabar 推理 button and faint curved connections.

BACKGROUND REFINEMENT: The original is too brown, opaque, heavily mottled and crowded. Replace its thick brown smoke and mottling with a quieter, airier DARK WARM ASH-GREY ink-and-silk field. Lift the midtones modestly, reduce brown saturation, reduce surface mottling dramatically. It is still a night scene, NOT white paper or daylight. Broad clear negative space through the middle and upper part, faint translucent mist with very gentle tonal depth. Keep just sparse, delicate, low-contrast mountain/camp/flag silhouettes in the lowest 15–20% and far edges; remove the dense black bristling forest of poles and flags. No bright lamp, moon, glowing right area or focal hotspot. Subtle fibre only. Antique ivory text with confident legibility, not glowing white. Thin low-opacity warm-grey curved graph lines, delicate shallow arcs without arrows.

LAYOUT: Reserve the far-right strip for a future detail float so the graph never needs to be covered. Main action 添入线索 around375,y545 and 推理 around580,y545. The main graph uses the left and central 77% of the screen. Leave the far right from approximately1330px onward quiet and EMPTY in this state. Do not add a divider or permanent third column.

EXACT CONTENT: header “思绪”, top-right “收起”. Initial thought exactly once “今夜有变，可能试探”, linked by a faint arc to question “不惊扰丞相，军情该交给谁？”.
Selected clue text exactly:
“今夜不得入帐”
“伯约受命接报”
“亲兵可通传”
All clue lettering uses EXACTLY the same small KaiTi size, weight and ordinary character spacing. Each strip fits its text; the third has FIVE characters, first two SIX, so its strip and trailing semi-transparent × end one character earlier. Left edges aligned. Use thin diffuse ink washes, no hard rectangle or bright outlines. Preserve only the current question-to-clues connections; this screen is BEFORE inference, so no inference result yet.
Actions “＋ 添入线索” and the compact matte cinnabar “推理” button keep the extra horizontal space from input. Button readable and clearly active.

OPEN PICKER: anchored just below 添入线索, aroundx355,y585,width610,height225. A thin translucent charcoal silk slip, lightly softened edges, quiet texture, no heavy embossed border or large shadow. REPLACE the old “见闻” heading with a real visible SEARCH INPUT, never show 见闻. Search input spans most of top row and shows a small simple magnifying-glass icon followed by placeholder “搜索线索”. One delicate inset darker field or fine muted edge makes it clearly an input, not a section title. Keep a separate close × at the far-right of picker, with clear gap from input. No search query in this state, all six options are visible in two compact columns. Entries share same small KaiTi font and natural glyph lengths, no individual equal-width tiles:
left row1 “敌骑尚未攻营” ＋ ; right row1 “敌军探问发令者” ＋
left row2 “亲兵可通传” ✓ ; right row2 “递话，不能决断” ＋
left row3 “今夜不得入帐” ✓ ; right row3 “伯约受命接报” ✓
Keep each plus or tick at its own column trailing position. No confirm footer, tabs, fake clue count or extra headings. Thin translucent dark material of picker matches clue underwashes and the future details, refined and compact.

Retain bottom-right controls “回看前文” and “回到最新” discreetly. All prose remains small regular KaiTi, only question and conclusion/initial thought one step larger. No oversized typography. Keep complete full screen, no crop, no device frame, no annotations, no extra text.
